'''Model Dz5 security doors''' were blast doors which included an artificial intelligence with a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocoder]] and [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] set in them, as well as an advanced [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] defense system. The front door of [[Captain Neg's house]] was of this type.

The Dz5 was an upgrade of the [[model Dx5 security door]].
